IDENT.title: Autonomous production control for matrix production based on deep Q-learning

A_DEFINITION__agent_term_used.evidence_quote:
Intelligent 
product agents decide which process should be performed on 
which machine based on a machine learning approach.

A_DEFINITION__agent_entity_types.evidence_quote:
Each product agent attempts to 
maximize its reward R

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_mechanism.evidence_quote:
Q-learning is used in combination with a fully connected feed 
forward neural network.

C_MEMORY__memory_historical.evidence_quote:
there is only one 
neural network with weights θ that is trained to approximate 
the q-function for all different product types

C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.value: Shared neural network weights plus experience replay buffer of past transitions
C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.evidence_quote:
an experience replay mechanism is used similar to 
[10] which randomly samples previous transitions

C_MEMORY__memory_realtime.evidence_quote:
the state vector contains 
information about other already dispatched product agents as 
well.

C_MEMORY__memory_scope.evidence_quote:
the vector additionally includes entries for all open processes 
for each dispatched agent.

C_MEMORY__memory_persists_across_episode.evidence_quote:
The deep Q-learning approach has been trained 
using the inter-arrival time pattern of N(70,5) and is applied in 
the scenario of increased dynamics.

C_MEMORY__memory_update_mechanism.evidence_quote:
The simulation model generates the data for the learning process 
and serves as environment for evaluation.

C_MEMORY__memory_requirements_stated.evidence_quote:
the performance increases further if information about other 
dispatched orders is fed to the neural network.

E_LEARNING__learning_present.evidence_quote: This paper presents an approach based on deep Q-learning

E_LEARNING__learning_type.evidence_quote:
Q-learning is used in combination with a fully connected feed 
forward neural network.

E_LEARNING__explores_beyond_predefined_e.evidence_quote:
Each agent can choose between a set of actions composed 
of machine and process combinations.

E_LEARNING__learning_quality_measured.evidence_quote:
After 13 
million iterations the model has difficulties to generalize and 
the throughput time increases again.

E_LEARNING__learning_quality_metric.value: Learning curve of reward and throughput time over training iterations
E_LEARNING__learning_quality_metric.evidence_quote: Fig.4. and Fig. 6. visualize the learning curve of the Qlearning framework.

E_LEARNING__uses_simulation_for_explorat.evidence_quote:
The simulation model serves as environment to generate 
training data for the neural network

E_LEARNING__simulation_model_source.evidence_quote:
the discrete event 
simulation model of a matrix production already introduced in
[4] is used

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__validation_level.evidence_quote:
the discrete event 
simulation model of a matrix production already introduced in
[4] is used as substitute for a real production system

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__metrics_reported.evidence_quote: compares the results in terms of throughput time,

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__baseline_compared_.evidence_quote:
compared to a rule-based approach also 
minimizing throughput time, discussed in [4].

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__disruption_types_h.evidence_quote:
An 
increase in dynamic in terms of volatile customer demand 
volume has been modeled using sinus-shaped demand patterns.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__system_scale.evidence_quote: The production system is defined by ten workstations

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__application_domain.evidence_quote: Matrix production refers to a highly flexible production system based on independent production cells

which machine
